h1: The 5 Best Under-Cabinet Motion Sensor Lights of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Under-Cabinet Motion Lights: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 5 under-cabinet motion sensor lights scored on battery size, sensing range, dimming and mode control for kitchens and closets.
summary: The EZVALO 5-Pack is the best under-cabinet motion light, with 2400mAh per bar, 12 feet of sensing and a remote. The MCGOR pair is the pick if you want an always-on mode alongside motion, and the ZioeYiue three-pack adds a stated 8 to 10 hours of runtime. Rihvy and YLXS are the smaller 8-inch and 7.9-inch options for tight shelves.
intro: Cordless under-cabinet lights have an unglamorous failure: they work beautifully for two weeks, and then the battery or the timer becomes the story. A bar that switches on at the right moment but dies in a month is worse than a cheap plug-in strip. Battery capacity and the way a light handles motion decide which ones keep working.

Five bars made this ranking after we excluded a model that lists no motion sensing at all. They are scored on stated battery size, sensing range and angle, brightness control and how many bars come in the box. Real runtime depends on how often your hand crosses the sensor, which is why battery capacity gets more weight than any lumen figure.

products.name: EZVALO 5-Pack 10 inch Under Cabinet Lights with Remote
products.verdict: Five 10-inch bars with 2400mAh each, 12 ft sensing and a remote.
products.description:
EZVALO's pack contains five 10 inch bars, each with a 2400mAh battery, a 120 degree detection angle out to 12 feet and a 0.1 second response. A remote comes in the box. It costs $25 to $50, the only pack above the under-$25 bracket.

The 2400mAh cell is the largest in the group, which is the spec that decides whether you recharge monthly or quarterly. A 0.1 second response matters in practice: the light is on before your hand reaches the shelf, where slower sensors leave you in the dark for a beat. It tops the ranking on those two numbers, plus the remote for switching modes without reaching under the cabinet.

Buy it to light a whole kitchen or workshop with one pack. Skip it if you only need two bars.
cons: Five bars may be too many
products.idealFor: Whole kitchens, workshops and long cabinet runs.
products.skipIf: You only need one or two bars.

products.name: MCGOR 10 inch Rechargeable Under Cabinet Lights 2 Pack
products.verdict: Motion, always-on and off modes with five dimming levels.
products.description:
MCGOR's pair uses 10 inch bars with 40 LEDs each, five levels of dimming and three modes: motion, always-on and off. It is rechargeable and costs under $25.

The always-on mode is the reason to pick it. Motion lights are wrong for tasks where you stand still, like chopping, and being able to hold the light on solves that. Five dimming levels also let you set glare for a late-night snack. It ranks second because the listing prints no battery capacity or sensing range, so the EZVALO is easier to trust. It is cheaper per bar than the EZVALO in a two-pack.

Buy it for kitchen counters where you work in one spot. Skip it if you want documented battery life.
products.idealFor: Counters where you stand still while working.
products.skipIf: You want a documented sensing range.

products.name: ZioeYiue Wireless Under Cabinet Lights 10 inch 3 Pack
products.verdict: Three 10-inch bars with 1800mAh batteries and a stated 8 to 10 hour runtime.
products.description:
ZioeYiue's three-pack offers 10 inch bars with 10 feet of 120 degree sensing, an 1800mAh battery, three color temperatures and a stated runtime of 8 to 10 hours. The battery is non-detachable. It costs under $25.

A stated runtime is rare, and 8 to 10 hours of active lighting is a helpful figure for planning charges. Three color temperatures let you choose warm for living areas or cooler for tasks. It ranks third because 1800mAh and 10 feet trail the EZVALO's 2400mAh and 12 feet. The non-detachable battery means you cannot swap in a spare, which limits repair.

Buy it for three cabinets or shelves at the lowest price per bar. Skip it if you want user-replaceable batteries.

products.name: Rihvy 8 inch Wireless Under Cabinet Lights 3 Pack
products.verdict: Eight-inch bars with stepless dimming and a motion plus light sensor.
products.description:
Rihvy's three-pack uses 8 inch bars with stepless dimming, a motion and light sensor and three color options including warm white. It costs under $25.

Stepless dimming lets you set any brightness instead of choosing from fixed steps, and the light sensor keeps the bars off in daytime when motion alone would waste battery. That combination is smart for a closet that gets sunlight. It ranks fourth because the listing gives no battery capacity, runtime or sensing range, so there is little to verify. At 8 inches, the bars also suit narrower shelves than the 10 inch models.

Buy it for small closets and shelves where space is tight. Skip it if you need documented battery numbers.
products.skipIf: You want a documented battery and range.

products.name: YLXS 5-Pack Motion Sensor Under Cabinet Light 7.9 inch
products.verdict: Five 7.9-inch bars with a 1100mAh USB-C battery and up to 100 lumens.
products.description:
YLXS sells five bars of 7.9 inches each, with 42 LEDs, up to 100 lumens, a 1100mAh USB-C battery and three work modes. It costs under $25.

Five bars for under $25 is the cheapest per-bar price in the roundup, and USB-C charging uses cables you already own. The 100 lumen figure is a helpful anchor, but the 1100mAh battery is the smallest here, about half the EZVALO's. It ranks last for that reason: more frequent recharging is the price of the low cost. The short 7.9 inch bars are also the least coverage per fixture.

Buy it for many small cabinets on a tight budget. Skip it for heavy daily use.
products.idealFor: Many small cabinets on a tight budget.
products.skipIf: The lights will trigger all day.

whatMatters.detail: Battery size in mAh sets how often you recharge. The EZVALO has 2400mAh per bar, the ZioeYiue 1800mAh and the YLXS 1100mAh. A bigger cell lasts longer between charges. Check the listing for mAh per bar, not a combined pack figure, and for any stated runtime.

Range is how far the sensor sees and angle is how wide. The EZVALO reaches 12 ft across 120 degrees, the ZioeYiue 10 ft. A short range can miss you at the edge of a long counter. Match range to the distance between the bar and where you stand.

Response time is how quickly the light comes on. The EZVALO lists 0.1 seconds, which is effectively instant. Slower sensors leave you reaching in the dark. It matters most in a pantry or closet, where you often open the door and grab one item.

An always-on mode, like the MCGOR's, keeps light steady for chopping or reading. Dimming levels or stepless control tune the glare. The Rihvy adds a light sensor so the bars stay off in daytime. Check whether the listing offers modes beyond motion-only.

Longer bars cover more of a cabinet, while shorter ones fit narrow shelves. Pack size determines cost per bar. The EZVALO and YLXS give five, the ZioeYiue and Rihvy three. Measure your cabinet underside before choosing, and leave room for the charging port.

faq.a: No. All five are wireless and rechargeable, with the YLXS charging by USB-C and the ZioeYiue using a non-detachable battery. Mount them under the cabinet and recharge them periodically rather than hardwiring.

faq.q: What is the most common mistake with cordless cabinet lights?
faq.a: Ignoring battery capacity. The YLXS has 1100mAh versus the EZVALO's 2400mAh. In a busy kitchen the smaller cell needs recharging far more often, so match capacity to how often the light triggers.

faq.q: Is the EZVALO worth it over the MCGOR?
faq.a: For a long run of cabinets, yes. The EZVALO gives five bars, 2400mAh each and a remote. The MCGOR is the better pick for two counters where you want an always-on mode.

Clean the underside of the cabinet, then follow the mounting method in each listing's instructions. Test the sensing angle before final placement, since the EZVALO and ZioeYiue use a 120 degree field.

faq.q: How long do they run between charges?
faq.a: Only the ZioeYiue states a runtime, 8 to 10 hours. Others depend on triggers per day and brightness. Dim the light on the MCGOR or Rihvy to extend battery life.

faq.q: Can I leave them on all the time?
faq.a: The MCGOR has an always-on mode, but leaving it on drains the battery faster than motion-only use. Switch back to motion when you finish the task.

finalTake: The EZVALO 5-Pack is the best under-cabinet motion light because it combines the largest stated battery, a 12 ft range and a remote. The MCGOR pair is the right pick for counters where you need an always-on mode, and the ZioeYiue is a three-bar option with a stated runtime. Choose Rihvy or YLXS for compact shelves and tight budgets.
